prs.title: fix(server): preserve plain JSON Schema in deprecated server.tool() overload
prs.author: stakeswky
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in server.tool() are not handled correctly — they silently fail or get misrouted during argument parsing and schema serialization. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in server.tool() are not handled correctly — they silently fail or get misrouted during argument parsing and schema serialization. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 adds a forward-compatible preservation path (`isLikelyJsonSchema` check at the serialization layer) and widens the `inputSchema` type to `ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema`, supporting the deprecated overload without breaking callers. PR #1596 instead throws at argument-parse time, which would break any existing code passing plain JSON Schema objects and is a harder migration path. #1617's approach is strictly additive; #1596's is breaking.
